best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["height"] - 0.006) < 1e-3 and abs(c["yaw"] - 1.329) < 1e-3:
        best_candidate = c
        break

grasp_result = grasp(best_candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
best_spot = None
for spot in spots["spots"]:
    if abs(spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - 1.329) < 1e-3:
        best_spot = spot
        break

carry_to(best_spot["x"], best_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=1.329)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
